description: WannaCry cyber attack and the NHS: National Audit Office investigation is published by National Audit Office. The official investigation documents the WannaCry attack's disruption of NHS services and preparedness. Its stated coverage is England; the May 2017 cyber incident. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The application account is available online as an HTML page; underlying model files and operational data were not inspected. The account is free to read; the terms and cost of its underlying tools and data are separate. outcomes: The NAO reports that at least 81 of 236 English trusts were affected and estimates that more than 19,000 appointments were cancelled. The investigation identifies unpatched systems and an untested local response plan; it does not establish the full disruption cost.
